description: A jQuery plugin named Readmore.js that provides functionality to truncate and expand content sections with 'Read More' and 'Close' links, including CSS embedding, toggle behavior, and resize handling.

classes.name: Readmore
classes.description: A constructor function for initializing the Readmore.js plugin on a DOM element with specified options.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up the content truncation, and binds resize event.

methods.name: toggleSlider
methods.description: Handles the toggle between expanded and collapsed states, including animations and callbacks.

methods.name: setBoxHeight
methods.description: Calculates and stores the full height of the content for toggling purposes.

methods.name: resizeBoxes
methods.description: Adjusts the height of all sections on window resize to maintain correct truncation.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes plugin classes, styles, event handlers, and data from the element.
